thread:
nina: FYI nightly SAST blew up this AM after an RBAC prune. lots of unrelated findings because fixtures couldn't be decrypted. anyone touch KMS perms? :eyes:

pete: that was me, PR 5601 removed decrypt for serviceAccount:ci-key-sa@redwood-prod to tighten scope. didn't realize some runners impersonate it. can revert now if that unblocks.

linda: sample error from scanner: "Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied for serviceAccount:ci-key-sa@redwood-prod" in job nightly-sast-03:00.

nina: first check audit logs to see if KMS saw requests (DENIED vs no log):
`gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="serviceAccount:ci-key-sa@redwood-prod" AND protoPayload.methodName:kms.*Decrypt" --limit=20 --format=json`

infra-bot: auto-created incident SEC-2026-3322222222. Owner: pete. Evidence retention: 14d.

pete: i'm reverting the binding now. quick terraform snippet: `google_project_iam_member` readding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for the SA, then follow-up with scoped grant.

oncall-sre: applying revert to infra-prod workspace... done. audit logs show DENIED entries at 03:00 then SUCCESS after revert.

nina: confirmed: kicked a fresh SAST run, decrypt succeeded, noise dropped. marking mitigated but keeping ticket open for follow-ups.

linda: proposals for SDLC/process: 1) pre-merge smoke `infra-smoke/kms-decrypt` when PR diffs touch cloudkms resources; 2) PR must include the log-query output proving decrypts are visible; 3) prefer key-scoped bindings or SA impersonation for CI; 4) require TTL annotation on any temporary regrant.

sec-bot: Label `infra:keystore-temp:SEC-2026-3322222222` applied to affected runs. Evidence preserved 14d.

pete: i'll update PR 5601 to reapply with a 30m TTL and link the incident. will add an Impact Statement in the description.

oncall-sre: filing INFRA-221 to add the infra-smoke preflight job that triggers on terraform diffs containing "cloudkms"; job will attempt a targeted decrypt using impersonation. also recommend alert: count of KMS Decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED for keystore SAs >1 in 5m -> page infra oncall.

nina: SAST/DAST triage: add label `infra:blocked:SEC-2026-3322222222` to affected runs so triage filters them, but keep findings archived for 14d.

linda: i'll draft the SDLC checklist PR (steps + example terraform snippet for minimal key-level binding and impersonation pattern). assigning to @nina for review.

pete: thanks everyone. owners: pete (PR update), linda (SDLC PR), oncall-sre (infra job + alert). i'll follow up once PR is updated. :thumbsup:
